name: Fluvoxamine
summary: Fluvoxamine is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI).
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Extensive hepatic oxidative demethylation produces multiple metabolites, which are cleared through the kidneys. Its inhibition of other drugs' CYP metabolism must not be confused with its own clearance pathways.
